summary: Stage an instance restore for next restart
description: Authenticates the archive, checks hashes, application version and migration compatibility, restores into an isolated database, validates Nginx. External database users need permission to create/drop a separate restore database. The active database is never overwritten. Requires confirmation exactly RESTORE followed by a space and the selected backup ID. Changes apply before services start at the next restart; the previous instance is retained until backend readiness.

403.description: Administrator permission required; backups disabled in demo mode

400.description: Invalid input or another instance operation is running

parameters.name: backupID
parameters.description: Encrypted archive identifier, never a filesystem path
